iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 47. POSITIVE: Reuters reports Iran indicated willingness to turn over enriched uranium. White House says Trump's 'red line' on enrichment remains. Ceasefire holding but fragile - 2-week window. CNN: US-Israel determined to wipe out Iran nuclear expertise. SPND network of subordinate orgs exposed. 440kg 60% HEU still at Isfahan. IAEA withdrawn. Uranium turnover signal is strongest de-escalation indicator yet. Diplomatic: MEDIUM-HIGH. Technical: CRITICAL. Probability DOWN to 37%. Falling.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 47. CRITICAL: Iran re-closed Strait of Hormuz after Israel Lebanon strikes (AP/Fortune). Al Jazeera: new Hormuz Protocol - Iran charging tolls in Chinese yuan, undermining petrodollar. AP: ceasefire 'hangs by a thread.' WSJ: Iran tightening grip on Hormuz despite ceasefire. IRGC controls new entry/exit pathways. Only 'friendly' ships granted passage. UK-led 40-nation coalition discussions ongoing. Mobilization: CRITICAL. Diplomatic: LOW. Probability UP to 35%. Rising.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel–Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 47. MIXED: BREAKING - Netanyahu authorized direct talks with Lebanon (AP Apr 9). BUT Israel intensified strikes - 254+ killed in latest wave. Hezbollah paused attacks under ceasefire (Reuters). Trump calls Lebanon 'separate skirmish.' UK/France/Macron urge Lebanon inclusion in ceasefire. Bloomberg: largest assault since invasion. 1.1M displaced. Talks authorization is first diplomatic opening but no ceasefire yet. Rhetoric: CRITICAL. Mobilization: CRITICAL. Probability DOWN slightly to 68% on talks news. Still most volatile zone.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: NATO Steadfast Dart-2026 exercise ongoing. OSW detailed analysis: Turkey pursuing strategic ambiguity on nuclear weapons. FM Fidan: Iran ambitions could push Turkey into nuclear arms race. Times of Israel blog warns Turkish nuclear weapon dangerous for Israel/India. Akkuyu nuclear plant commissioning. B61-12 transition excludes Turkey. Stable at 11%.

india.name: India–Pakistan
india.notes: ESCALATORY: CFR rates renewed India-Pakistan conflict as Tier II contingency (moderate risk) - US think tank warns of potential armed conflict in 2026. US Annual Threat Assessment: India-Pakistan relations 'remain at risk of nuclear conflict.' May 2025 'first drone war' anniversary approaching. Pakistan Defence Minister nuclear signaling continues. India rejects US mediation. Pakistan engaging Iran/Egypt in parallel talks. Rhetoric: HIGH. Diplomatic: LOW. Probability UP to 22%. Rising.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 47. Iran war = strategic windfall for Russia (Axios/WaPo): surging oil, diverted Western attention, strained NATO. Russia concerned about upcoming NPT Review Conference (Jamestown). Medvedev nuclear threats continue. Rutte: NATO moving from 'unhealthy' dependence on US. NPR: Varoufakis says China is biggest winner of Iran war. Strategic Rocket Forces 90% modernized. New START expired, no replacement. Probability DOWN slightly to 56%. Stable.

china.name: China
china.notes: ESCALATING TECHNICAL: ISW China-Taiwan Update Apr 3 confirms ongoing PLA activity. Taiwan Warns of China Hybrid Tactics (Apr 8). KMT Chairwoman Cheng Li-wun Beijing visit ongoing. Taiwan military: budget delay threatens $2.4B weapons buying + F-16 training. DPP promoting $40B drone procurement. CNN investigation: China secretly expanding nuclear weapons infrastructure. Asia Times: nuclear-response drills for Taiwan scenario. Technical: CRITICAL. Mobilization: HIGH. Probability UP to 13%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: 3RD missile launch in 2 days (Apr 8) - multiple SRBMs from Wonsan, 240km each (AP/Boston25/Politico). VP FM Jang Kum-chol: South Korea most hostile enemy state, world-startling fools. Kim observed cruise missile test from new destroyer. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. Kim demands US nuclear recognition. 38 North: solid-propellant ICBM, tactical nukes, LACMs all deployed. Rhetoric: CRITICAL. Technical: CRITICAL. Stable at 88%.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia–Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1140+. Arms Control: Russia concocting Ukrainian bomb claims - potential pretext for nuclear escalation (confirmed by ACA). Kremlin warns of potential threat of Ukraine acquiring nuclear weapons. New START expired Feb 2026, no replacement. ISW Apr 8: Ukrainian strikes on Russian assets in Donetsk continue. GCRI nuclear war analysis published. Bulletin Doomsday Clock: nuclear risk continued in third year of war. Probability DOWN slightly to 80%. Stable.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan–Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: DIPLOMATIC BREAKTHROUGH SUSTAINED: China-hosted Urumqi talks confirmed by multiple sources (AP/Al Jazeera/Bloomberg/NPR). Both sides committed to ceasefire. China actively mediating per FM spokesperson Mao Ning. VP Vance delegation heading to Islamabad this weekend. Sporadic mortar incidents continue - Pakistan fired mortars killing 2 Afghan civilians Apr 2. Taliban abandoned some border posts. Diplomatic: HIGH. Probability DOWN to 6%. Falling.
